title: Barracuda Networks security advisory (AV26-1112)
description: As of November 2, 2026, Barracuda Networks is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG)
	Prior to 9.4.0.030

Barracuda Load Balancer Application Delivery Controller (ADC)
	Prior to 6.4.0

Barracuda Web Application Firewall (WAF)
	Prior to 11.0.1

Barracuda Web Security Gateway (WSG)
	Prior to 16.1.100.100

Barracuda WAF Control Center (WCC)
	Prior to 2.2.1
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
